title: Qwen3-32B W8A8 · Ascend 910B4

lede.zh: Qwen3-32B W8A8 在四张 Ascend 910B4 上的标准化服务测试。单流 TPOT 为 17.68 ms；高生成量负载在 C64 达到 1,529 tok/s。
lede.en: Standardized serving measurements for Qwen3-32B W8A8 on four Ascend 910B4 accelerators. Single-stream TPOT is 17.68 ms; the long-generation workload reaches 1,529 tok/s at C64.

snapshot.zh: 固定长度 · ShareGPT · 长上下文 · Agent · 开放环容量
snapshot.en: Fixed length · ShareGPT · long context · Agent · open-loop capacity

stats.zhLabel: 高生成量 C64 输出

heading.zh: 测试数值必须绑定负载形状
heading.en: Keep each result attached to its workload

intro.zh: 本报告展示固定长度、ShareGPT、长上下文、Agent 和开放环容量结果。不同部署配方之间不拼接曲线；有限闭环批量灌入的排队时间不作为用户延迟。
intro.en: The report covers fixed-length, ShareGPT, long-context, Agent, and open-loop capacity workloads. Results from different deployment recipes are not joined into one curve; queue time from finite closed-loop batches is not user latency.

note.zh: Agent 数字来自单独的自配方部署；官方高吞吐配方的 max-model-len 为 5,500，无法覆盖该 Agent 请求。Agent 与其他配置不可直接并列解释。分位数仅在满足样本门槛时报告。
note.en: Agent measurements use a separate custom deployment; the official high-throughput recipe has a 5,500 max-model-len and cannot run that Agent workload. Do not treat Agent and other configurations as directly comparable. Percentiles are reported only when sample thresholds are met.

heading.zh: 单流延迟、并发吞吐与长上下文分别呈现不同工作区间
heading.en: Single-stream latency, concurrent throughput, and long-context prefill occupy different operating regions

intro.zh: 四卡 Ascend 910B4、TP4。固定负载使用对应官方 A2 配方；高并发与长上下文属于不同配置，不应拼成同一条连续曲线。
intro.en: Four Ascend 910B4 accelerators with TP4. Fixed workloads use their corresponding A2 recipes; high-concurrency and long-context points use distinct configurations and should not be read as one continuous curve.

notes.zh: 长上下文点以输入吞吐为主读数
notes.en: Read the long-context point primarily by input throughput

notes.zh: 该场景的输出吞吐为 22.6 tok/s，输入吞吐为 5,790.7 tok/s；TPOT 中位数 490.46 ms。它不代表短请求服务速度。
notes.en: This point reports 22.6 output tok/s and 5,790.7 input tok/s, with a 490.46 ms median TPOT. It does not represent short-request serving speed.

title.zh: 输出吞吐：高生成量负载

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: SLO 口径改变可接受的请求到达率
heading.en: The request rate depends on the selected SLO

intro.zh: 在 512 输入 / 256 输出请求形状下进行开放环容量测试。safe_rps 是该负载及阈值下的实验边界，不是其他请求长度的服务承诺。
intro.en: Open-loop capacity was tested with 512 input / 256 output. safe_rps is specific to this workload and threshold, not a service guarantee for other request lengths.

notes.zh: 收紧 TPOT P95 后，容量边界从 4.97 降至 2.78 req/s。阈值组合必须随容量数字一并引用。
notes.en: Adding a TPOT P95 limit reduces the measured boundary from 4.97 to 2.78 req/s. Quote the threshold together with the rate.

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

zh: TTFT P95 ≤ 1,000 ms + TPOT P95 ≤ 50 ms
en: TTFT P95 ≤ 1,000 ms + TPOT P95 ≤ 50 ms

methodIntro: 固定长度场景按各自官方配方运行；开放环容量使用预注册 SLO。Agent 场景采用单独的自配方，长上下文使用专用配置。
Fixed-length workloads use their respective official recipes; open-loop capacity follows preregistered SLOs. Agent uses a separate custom recipe, and long context uses a dedicated configuration.

methodNotes.zh: 有限闭环的 1,000 请求批次中，TTFT 包含排队时间，不解释为交互延迟或容量边界。
methodNotes.en: For finite closed-loop batches of 1,000 requests, TTFT includes queueing and is not interactive latency or a capacity boundary.

methodNotes.zh: 六个有效标准化场景没有抢占；Agent 客户端输入吞吐口径存在限制，报告使用服务端指标。
methodNotes.en: No preemptions were observed in the six valid standardized workloads. The Agent client-side input-throughput counter has a known limitation; server-side metrics were used.
